# Consent Script — AI Tool Adoption Survey

## Purpose

This survey investigates how programme coordinators at accredited institutions
adopt AI tools in quality assurance processes. Participation is voluntary.

## Privacy and Data Protection

Your responses are **confidential within the named research-team boundary**
[ARS drafting convention in irb_terminology_glossary.md: the team can link the
email and response during the stated 12-month lifecycle, with the access and
disclosure commitments below]. We collect your institutional email address for
the purpose of inviting selected respondents to a follow-up interview. Your
email and identity will not appear in any published report. Only the named
research team will see identified data.

Identified data (email + responses) will be retained for 12 months after project
close, then deleted. Published reports will contain aggregate results only; no
record-level dataset release is planned. This is a project-specific reporting
commitment, not an authority-defined de-identification status.

This survey is not anonymous within that ARS project drafting convention: the
named research team receives your institutional email and can link it to your
response during the stated lifecycle. If you do not wish your email retained,
please do not participate.

## Contact

For questions about this study (IRB-2024-001), contact the principal investigator
at research@example-university.edu.
